title: HIPAA terms
description: Identifiers for HIPAA concepts that no external vocabulary supplies, minted by RFC 0016 for operator_role and data_classes. Each definition is a paraphrase; the cited section of the Code of Federal Regulations is authoritative. Publishing a term does not interpret the regulation, and declaring one makes nothing compliant.

terms.label: Covered entity
terms.definition: A health plan, a health care clearinghouse, or a health care provider that transmits health information electronically in connection with a transaction covered by HIPAA.

terms.label: Business associate
terms.definition: A person or organisation that, on behalf of a covered entity and other than as a member of its workforce, creates, receives, maintains or transmits protected health information, or provides services to a covered entity that involve disclosing it.

terms.label: Protected health information
terms.definition: Individually identifiable health information transmitted or maintained in any form or medium, excluding certain education and employment records.

terms.label: Electronic protected health information
terms.definition: Protected health information that is transmitted by, or maintained in, electronic media.

terms.label: Limited data set
terms.definition: Protected health information that excludes the direct identifiers listed in the regulation for the individual and for their relatives, employers and household members.

terms.label: De-identified health information
terms.definition: Health information that does not identify an individual and offers no reasonable basis to identify one, as established by expert determination or by removing the identifiers the regulation lists. De-identified information is not protected health information.
